summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with one parametrized test (19 cases, module-scoped Turtle fixture). The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (40 passed). Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not available in the shared venv or on the system, so type-checking and formatting were checked by reading only. Possible mypy warn_unreachable hit on the non-node raise in shacl.py, and the type-ignore comments in the test may need adjusting. No commits made.
